scope: Sequential separate-process full-size build-to-export runs in the Codex execution environment; not the user's full live NBA slate or Streamlit Cloud hardware
changes: Ordered SciPy CSR lineup scoring instead of repeated NumPy slot-gather temporaries
Direct event-subset row indexing rather than chained five-player array copies
validation: Existing frozen event-ledger hashes unchanged for weighted, zero and single-role FD/DK cases
Isolated 10000-scenario old/new game events, scores and counters byte-equivalent
Scoring preserves exact original roster-slot addition order across float32, float64, integer and strided inputs
Weighted duplicate payouts and ties checked against explicitly expanded opponents
Metrics identical across single-scenario and 128-scenario batches, including histogram and sorting paths
limitations: Single paired full-size measurement; runtime varies with hardware, slate size, concurrency and cache state. No projection, rotation, ownership, payout or sample-count policy changed. The faster but rounding-different batched rank experiment was not retained.
